lessons.title: What is Classification? 🏷️
lessons.description: Learn how machines sort data into categories — binary, multi‑class, and multi‑label — with real‑world examples.

lessons.title: Logistic Regression: The Sigmoid 🧬
lessons.description: Understand odds, log‑odds, and the sigmoid function that turns a line into a probability.

lessons.title: Logistic Regression: Cost & Learning 📉
lessons.description: Master log‑loss, gradient descent for classification, and interpreting the decision boundary.

lessons.title: Decision Trees: Pick a Path 🌳
lessons.description: Build a tree that asks questions; impurity measures (Gini, entropy) and information gain explained.

lessons.title: k‑Nearest Neighbors (k‑NN) 👥
lessons.description: Classify by majority vote; distance metrics, the curse of dimensionality, and choosing k.

lessons.title: Evaluation Metrics for Classification 📊
lessons.description: Confusion matrix, accuracy, precision, recall, F1‑score, and the ROC‑AUC curve — pick the right metric.

lessons.title: Comparing Classifiers & Bias‑Variance 🧭
lessons.description: How to choose the best algorithm, tackle overfitting/underfitting, and use cross‑validation in classification.
